title: Good to know
summary: What RetailOps deliberately doesn't do: nothing orders by itself, forecasts don't know about holidays, and some data only comes from a file.

items: **Nothing orders by itself.** Reorder Candidates and New order are decision support. Send PO emails a vendor only when someone presses Send. Suggested deliveries, Looks closed in {pos} and suggested schedules all wait for a person to confirm.
**RetailOps never changes your POS.** It reads sales, menus and stock from {pos}. Prices, counts and items are changed in {pos} itself.
**No vendor cost or lead time from {pos}.** Lead time comes from the Vendor Calendar schedule, or the number you set.
**Forecasts use your own sales history.** They don't know about holidays, promotions, weather or events ahead.
**Stock is as fresh as the latest stock list**: your last upload, or {pos}'s nightly list once Inventory from {pos} is on.
**Some pages need data your POS doesn't give.** Those pages show as not available for your store.

blocks.text: If something you need is missing, tell us at {support_email}. Requests from stores shape what we build next.
